source: JPL Horizons API, fetched 2026-08-17; observer on the lunar surface at Grimaldi (CENTER=coord@301, COORD_TYPE=GEODETIC, east-positive); QUANTITIES=14,15 apparent sub-observer and sub-solar planetodetic latitudes in degrees, APPARENT=AIRLESS. For Saturn the sub-observer latitude is the ring opening angle B; the 2029 epoch has the rings wide open so a sign or scale error cannot hide near a plane crossing. Convert to planetocentric with tan(centric) = tan(detic) * (polar/equatorial radius)^2 before comparing with a pole-vector dot product.
